name: [🎨] Catch the Artist!
desc:
🖌️ DRAW. 🎭 BLEND IN. 🗳️ VOTE.

One player is the IMPOSTER... but they DON'T KNOW the secret theme! While everyone else draws the correct theme, the Imposter must guess what it is and blend in before getting caught.

🎨 Draw the secret theme as an Innocent.
👀 Spot the fake drawing.
🎭 Trick everyone as the Imposter.
🗳️ Vote out the suspicious player.
🏆 Unlock Chairs, Pens, Titles & Animations.
💰 Earn Cash every game.
👥 Play with your friends!

👍 LIKE the game!
⭐ FAVOURITE to support us!
👥 JOIN the group for a FREE reward!

🎉 New updates and cosmetics added regularly!
